title: AiXapply: Fast and Reliable Full-File Code Integration with Specialized Small Models for IDE Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.07634v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models increasingly assist developers by proposing small code edits, yet reliably integrating a partial update snippet into an existing file while preserving unrelated content remains poorly supported by current code-generation workflows. We formalize the Code Integration (Apply) task as follows: given an original file and an update snippet, the system must produce the complete merged file while preserving all content outside the requested edit. We construct a high-quality multi-language dataset from real commits via a structured pipeline that converts code changes into update snippets paired with full-file ground truth and enforces consistency through verification and filtering. We then train a specialized 4B model, aiXapply, using supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (GRPO). translated_title: AiXapply：面向IDE工作流、基于专用小型模型的快速可靠全文件代码集成
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地通过提出小型代码编辑来辅助开发者，然而如何将部分更新片段可靠地集成到现有文件中并保留无关内容，目前的代码生成工作流仍缺乏良好支持。我们将代码集成任务形式化如下：给定一个原始文件和一个更新片段，系统必须生成完整的合并文件，同时保留所请求编辑之外的所有内容。我们通过结构化流水线从真实提交中构建了高质量的多语言数据集，该流水线将代码变更转换为与全文件真值配对的更新片段，并通过验证和过滤保证一致性。随后，我们使用监督微调和强化学习（GRPO）训练了一个专用的4B模型aiXapply。监督微调版本在我们的语言感知比较下达到94.4%的准确率，超越了强大的大模型基线（Deepseek-V3.2）。
tldr: 该论文将代码集成任务形式化为根据原始文件与更新片段生成完整合并文件的问题，构建了基于真实提交的多语言数据集，并通过监督微调与GRPO强化学习训练出专用4B模型aiXapply，以94.4%的准确率超越大模型基线，为IDE工作流提供快速可靠的全文件代码集成。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the Code Integration (Apply) task—generating a complete merged file from an original file and an update snippet—and trains a specialized 4B model, aiXapply, via supervised fine-tuning and GRPO reinforcement learning, achieving 94.4% accuracy and surpassing large-model baselines for fast, reliable full-file code integration in IDE workflows.
